clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points out something most people never connect: the ancient kosher dietary law and the advice he's already given about pork and shellfish line up almost exactly.

His read: the kosher rule says a land animal is fine to eat only if it has a split hoof and chews the cud - which is exactly why pork is out.

The water rule is just as simple: only eat what comes from a lake, river or ocean and has fins and scales.

A quick filter worth keeping in your head next time you're ordering.
